# The Standard Playbook

> High-performance coaching for elite entrepreneurs specializing in insurance agency growth, producer development, and sales training. Based in Fort Wayne, Indiana. Founded by Justin — Founder & Head Coach.

The Standard Playbook (standardplaybook.com) helps insurance agency owners and producers build systematic, high-performing businesses through coaching, masterminds, and technology-powered training platforms. The company operates as Standard Playbook INC (DBA Agency Brain).

## Coaching Programs

- [The Mirror Challenge](https://standardplaybook.com/mirror): The 8-Week / 32-Day Mirror Challenge. $197 one time, free with Agency Brain or any Standard Playbook program.
- [The Boardroom](https://standardplaybook.com/boardroom): $399/month. Weekly group coaching call Monday 1pm EST, Boardroom tool access inside Agency Brain, Agency Brain Core, Telegram, both Fort Wayne member events, and the Mirror Challenge free.
- [Momentum](https://standardplaybook.com/momentum): $2.5k/month. Directive-level work, twice the conversation: two 90-minute 1:1 coaching and implementation calls per month, the weekly Monday group call, Boardroom tool access, Agency Brain Pro, and Telegram access.
- [The Team Standard](https://standardplaybook.com/team-standard): Team Standard 2X ($2.5k/month, two fifty-minute team calls a month) or 4X ($4k/month, four). Both include a 45-minute owner coaching call a month, a private messaging channel with the team, Weekly Return & Reports to the owner, Agency Brain Pro, the Monday Boardroom call and live events for the owner, and the Mirror Challenge free.
- [The 8-Week Sales Management Experience](https://standardplaybook.com/sales-experience): $4.5k or $625/week. A full sales management system install in 8 weeks, with a full money-back guarantee: stay in the 8 weeks, do the work, and if you want your money back, ask.
- [Standard 90](https://standardplaybook.com/standard90): $15k ($5k/month for 3 months). Daily 1:1 work for 90 days with the owner, the manager, and the team, with two calls every week. Framework live by day 90 or Justin keeps working free.
- [The Standard Ascension](https://standardplaybook.com/ascension): Twelve weeks of private mentorship by application. Apply to see the investment.
- [The Directive](https://standardplaybook.com/directive): $1.5k/month, waitlist only. Intensive 1:1 implementation coaching with direct access to Justin.
- [The 6 Week Producer Challenge](https://standardplaybook.com/the-challenge): 42-day execution system for insurance producers. Rolling enrollment with daily 3-5 minute video modules, Core 4 habit tracking, weekly Discovery Stacks, and 60-day app access. $299/producer.

## Technology Platform

- [Agency Brain](https://myagencybrain.com/info): The insurance-agency operating system. Core $299/month (20 AI-scored sales calls), Plus $449/month (50 calls, AI Training Studio, AI builders, Life Targets, 90 Day Audio), Pro $599/month (100 calls, HR Suite, priority support). Live Call Coach is a $129 per rep a month add-on on any tier. AI call scoring is included in every plan.
- [Certified Standard](https://standardplaybook.com/certified-standard): $399 per seat, one time. AI sales certification on the full Hello-to-Bind call.
- [The Standard Playbook App](https://standardplaybook.com/app): Sales training and accountability platform featuring The Armory (30 training modules), Core 4 Tracker (habit gamification), and 19 Stacking frameworks.
